description: This file implements a message action runner for a messaging system, handling different types of message actions such as send, broadcast, poll, and plugin actions. It includes functions for resolving channels, preparing messages, and executing actions with support for cross-context decoration and media handling.

methods.name: getToolResult
methods.description: Extracts the tool result from a message action result if available.

methods.name: collectActionMediaSourceHints
methods.description: Collects media source hints from action parameters.

methods.name: applyCrossContextMessageDecoration
methods.description: Applies cross-context decoration to a message and updates parameters accordingly.

methods.name: maybeApplyCrossContextMarker
methods.description: Conditionally applies cross-context marker decoration to a message based on context.

methods.name: resolveChannel
methods.description: Resolves the target channel based on parameters and context.

methods.name: resolveActionTarget
methods.description: Resolves the target recipient or channel for a message action.

methods.name: resolveGateway
methods.description: Resolves the gateway configuration for message sending.

methods.name: handleBroadcastAction
methods.description: Handles broadcasting a message to multiple targets.

methods.name: handleSendAction
methods.description: Handles sending a message, including media and reply options.

methods.name: handlePollAction
methods.description: Handles creating and sending a poll message.

methods.name: handlePluginAction
methods.description: Handles plugin-based message actions via dispatch.

methods.name: runMessageAction
methods.description: Main entry point to execute a message action based on input parameters.
